About AchieveX.

X
FIVE-WEEK ACADEMIC CHAMPIONSHIP

A little competition.
A lot of growth.

AchieveX brings learning and healthy competition together. Test your knowledge, challenge your abilities, and improve with every weekly assessment — alongside students who are doing the same.

05WEEKLY ROUNDS
500MAXIMUM POINTS
₹100REGISTRATION VIA ERP
01 / THE FORMAT

Find your category

Junior is for first-year students. Senior is for second-, third-, and fourth-year students, with a choice of Core or CS track. Senior track choices are final after registration.

02 / THE CLIMB

Every round adds up

Each weekly test is worth 100 points. Rankings are cumulative and released weekly alongside answer keys. Final ties follow pre-announced committee criteria.

03 / THE COMEBACK

Keep moving forward

A recovery mechanism will help participants bounce back from missed or low scores. The exact rule will be announced by the organising committee.

04 / THE RECOGNITION

Celebrate the journey

Weekly top performers, the Biggest Climber, and Perfect Five attendance receive special recognition. Fair play is essential: malpractice results in disqualification.
